name: Steam Glance
description: Adds interactive previews and smart badges to Steam links. View game details, top reviews, trailers, price comparisons, and wishlist state.
author: GGJacob

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; media-src 'self' blob: https://*.steamstatic.com https://store.steampowered.com https://video.akamai.steamstatic.com; connect-src 'self' https://store.steampowered.com https://steamcommunity.com https://api.steampowered.com https://api.isthereanydeal.com https://*.steamstatic.com https://video.akamai.steamstatic.com
